name: Waypoint-clarified prompts
description: Full prompt requests plus explicit waypoint-vs-sector disambiguation cues.
rationale: Rationale: <=2 sentences. Mention the top Decision Support factor(s), especially waypoint progress/timing; do not use sector corners as movement targets unless they are the waypoint.
action: Action: choose one of wait, move, broadcast. Follow Special directive if present. Prefer the Decision Support Summary recommendation when legal.
action_move: Direction: choose ONLY from Legal moves. Use the immediate Plan focus waypoint as target; sector bounds are constraints, not direct move goals.
action_broadcast: Message: If broadcast, send the JSON coverage plan on the first turn. Otherwise send a brief update only when co-located drones need it.
memory_update: Memory: Use tags PLAN:, SECTOR:, RV:, FIG:, POSSIBLE:, NOTE:, VISITED:. Keep existing VISITED lines. Do NOT copy Decision Support, Legal movements, or Broadcast Rx Buffer.
